items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I saw Red Callender and (unintelligible) up on the band... [INTERVIEWEE] Sure.

ctx.x: I saw that. That's why I'm asking you that question, because I saw a couple of -- I saw Red Callender and (unintelligible) up on the band, and a lot of very unhappy faces.
